text:
nina-sec: Quick sync — we need an atomic TLS profile rollout for eu/apac to remove legacy curves and enforce TLS1.3-preferred. Avoid partial handshakes like this morning.

raj-sre: +1. Propose: preflight that verifies config-version on every proxy node and blocks flip unless all nodes match. That prevented the incident.

lina-platform: can do. I'll add a config-version check to the deploy job and gate the feature flag flip. Also adding a canary_percent var for 1/5/25.

omar-eng: KMS/RBAC: rotator SA must get cryptoKeySigner with condition limiting use to rotator service. I'll open the IAM PR. Make sure we add an alert for AsymmetricSign denials.

cert-bot: scan: 19 hosts in eu/apac still advertise secp256k1 older stack. Listed in #eng-runtime. Recommend targeted remediation before 100% flip.

jen-compliance: Compliance needs CHG with CVE mapping, canary metrics, and audit snapshots for 180 days. cc me when ready.

nina-sec: rollback criteria: compat-pool >0.5% traffic OR handshake-error >2x baseline OR >5 production accounts affected. If hit, flip feature flag and revert config-version.

raj-sre: I'll add dashboards and an alert that pages on those thresholds with runbook link.

lina-platform: infra PR in 30m with plan output. Planning start: Tue 09:00 UTC for 1% canary.

nina-sec: thanks all — post canary summary here and attach audit export.
